# axiolid-model

## Overview

The format-neutral geometry graph that source adapters lower into and
kernels consume: an immutable, append-only DAG of typed nodes preserving
exact curves, surfaces, profiles, primitives, topology, curve and surface
relations, CSG instructions and instancing, alongside source meshes. Handles
are branded per graph and references must point to earlier nodes of the
right family, so cycles, dangling references and cross-graph handles cannot
be built. It evaluates, tessellates and compiles nothing, and keeps source
identifiers outside the graph.

The optional `serde` feature (off by default) adds the graph's versioned
wire format (ADR 0085): `GeometryGraph::to_json`, `from_json`, `to_cbor`
and `from_cbor`, and the `wire` module. Every payload names its format and
`MAJOR.MINOR` version; additions are minor versions and anything else is
major. A reader refuses by name a version it does not read, a kind,
variant or field it does not know, a non-finite number and a graph that
fails the builder's validation, and never returns part of a payload.

## Features

Default: none.

| Feature | Enables |

## Changes

Latest release, 0.3.9 (2026-10-10):

### Added

- A seam-snapping window on an oriented station (#294, ADR 0082
  amendment): `OrientedCurveStation::seam_window`, set by
  `with_seam_window`, a non-negative distance in the basis's station
  measure (default `0`, the arc-length tolerance alone, so every existing
  station reads as before). A resolver reads a station within the window
  of one seam whose frame may jump on that seam, from its `SeamSide`, and
  refuses a window holding two seams or a seam whose certified position
  straddles its edge. It also applies to the station of an
  `InstanceAtStation`. A negative or non-finite window is refused as
  `GraphError::InvalidStation` when the node is pushed.
- Wire format 1.1 (ADR 0085): the window is written as `seam_window` and
  omitted at `+0.0`, so a graph without windows writes the 1.0 graph; an
  absent window reads as `0`, so every 1.0 payload still reads to the same
  graph. A payload claiming 1.0 that holds a window is refused as
  `WireError::UnknownField`. `FORMAT_VERSION` is `1.1`; the 1.0 golden
  payloads stay and a 1.1 one is added.
